statement: The entire actual radial periodic group of C84 and the radial and logarithmic-spiral relative centralizers of C85-C86 admit continuous global contractions fixing the identity. The construction uses the C85 cutoff, a continuous actual support height, literal vertical normalizers, and a topological isomorphism between the zero-twist compact-annulus identity component and the supported plane subgroup. All original boundary and integer operator labels and both inverse topologies are retained.
depends_on: C84 exact original group topology; C85 global continuous cutoff; C86 actual spiral comparison; Epstein1966 Theorem3.1 and AppendixA1-A2 with their proofs for proper arcs relative to the entire boundary; Yagasaki2000 compact boundary-relative Lemma2.1(ii); integer boundary-shift homomorphism, exact kernel, continuous lower-fixed lift, actual closed-disk normalizers and the global pasted contraction proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), global actual contractions of the two specified discrete-cyclic relative centralizers.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The annulus lift fixes the lower line pointwise and has a continuous integer upper shift. Its zero kernel is proved by the exact relative arc homotopy, Epstein's pointwise boundary-fixed ambient isotopy, a parameter correction and the disk Alexander isotopy. A single compact-annulus contraction is then fixed on its whole identity component; no varying choice of the arc isotopies is used. Vertical rescaling acts through an explicit original closed-disk normalizer with a displayed inverse.
computational_checks: The exact producer code/part_b/c87_global_contraction_certificate.py and adjacent JSON/stdout pass 42 exact checks of the annulus twist and operator labels, relative correction faces, vertical conjugation and its inverse, weighted scaling constants, closed-disk normalizer and support-height identities, and the global homotopy faces. The topological component, source theorem applications and whole-group continuity are proved in the text.

Original PDFs were reopened and saved under work/part_b/research_data/epstein1966_isotopies.pdf and yagasaki2000_homeomorphism_groups.pdf. Epstein Theorem3.1 printed89-90 and AppendixA1-A2 with their proofs printed105-106 were checked; A2's printed statement omits an explicit PL conclusion, so the citation retains its proof, which invokes A1 after the endpoint correction. Yagasaki Lemma2.1(ii) and its proof on printed2-3 were reread with the entire boundary fixed pointwise.
notes: This is a single contraction on each entire actual topological group, strengthening the prior positive homotopy-group vanishing. The exact normalizer and support-height maps supply the global parameter dependence. No general discrete-operator or general C12 contraction is inferred. Earlier accepted fragments remain unchanged.
